# UN World Food Programme (WFP)

> > The world's largest humanitarian organization fighting hunger through emergency relief, nutrition programs, and resilience-building across 120+ countries in crisis.

WFP is a UN agency that provides food assistance, cash transfers, and humanitarian aid to vulnerable populations affected by conflict, climate change, and food insecurity. The site serves as a central hub for news, operations data, governance information, and resources for media, donors, and humanitarian professionals.

## Key Topics

- Food security
- Emergency response
- Humanitarian aid
- Hunger relief
- Nutrition programs
- Cash transfers
- Climate action
- Resilience building
- Conflict and hunger
- Global hunger crisis
- WFP operations
- Sudan
- Yemen
- Afghanistan
- Executive Board

## About WFP

- [UN World Food Programme (WFP)](https://www.wfp.org): WFP homepage: world's largest humanitarian organization fighting hunger
- [Who we are | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/who-we-are): WFP mission and overview as world's largest humanitarian organization
- [History | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/history): WFP history from 1961 founding to Nobel Peace Prize recipient
- [Governance and leadership | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/governance-and-leadership): WFP governance structure, Executive Board and leadership team
- [Funding and donors | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/funding-and-donors): WFP funding sources from governments, corporations and individuals

## WFP Operations & Mission

- [Our work | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/our-work): WFP work across 120+ countries on hunger relief and resilience
- [Ending hunger | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/ending-hunger): WFP mission to end global hunger and food insecurity crisis
- [Conflict and hunger | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/conflict-and-hunger): WFP analysis of conflict as main driver of global food crises

- [Stories | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/stories): Humanitarian stories and crisis coverage from WFP operations globally

## Accountability & Governance

- [Performance management and accountability | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/performance-management-accountability): WFP performance reporting and corporate results framework
- [Independent evaluation | World Food Programme](https://www.wfp.org/independent-evaluation): WFP independent evaluations and accountability mechanisms
